name: waypoint-organization-service
description: waypoint-organization-service tooling: 16 wp-organization-* agents (module, domain, use case, endpoint, event, persistence, migration, test and deployment builders plus read-only architecture, contract, security, observability and performance reviewers for the organization service, plus a .github maintainer), 17 /wp-* commands, 13 path-scoped rules, 18 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a waypoint-organization-service checkout.
